question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**emotional**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of given words.
 
 
• **impressive: **evoking admiration through size, quality, or skill; grand, imposing, or awesome.
 
• **exciting: **causing great enthusiasm and eagerness.
 
• **emotional: **arousing or characterized by intense feeling.
 
• **expressive: **effectively conveying thought or feeling.
 
 
 
• ​As per the meaning of the given words, "**emotional**" is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
• In the given sentence, the implied meaning of the given sentence is that the crowd was feeling an intense emotion at the demise of the footballing legend. So, "emotional" is the correct word choice. 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**

**The complete passage is: **Football legend Diego Maradona was buried in a private ceremony after a day of ***(1) emotional*** scenes in the Argentine capital Buenos Aires. Only*** (2) around*** two dozen relatives and close friends and ***(3) attended*** the final ceremony on Thursday. But ***(4) earlier ***huge crowds turned out to pay** (5) their** respects, with many weeping, blowing kisses, and praying as they filed past his coffin.
